summary: The technical-preview core product loop is code-backed by credential-free verification: idea intake, deep clarification, research evidence, readiness gates, browser/service boundaries, and staged auto-implementation review loops all have local smoke coverage. Broad/general release remains governed separately by release-readiness gates.

checkedBehaviors: Idea intake creates a user-confirmed business or personal project purpose before analysis.
Active question batches stay bounded while long sessions can process 200+ question/answer loops.
Answers produce follow-up debt and research-task debt instead of hidden notes.
Question-debt completion and Planning Handoff blockers remain visible before Planning-ready.
Read-only public-web research runs require an active allowlist and bounded concurrency.
Imported source-traced results synthesize evidence matrices and evidence packs.
Research review cards retain source traces and expose pro/con/uncertainty quality gates.
Research-generated follow-up questions return to the Decision Queue as answerable debt.
Completeness keeps question debt and source-trace gaps from being labelled Planning-ready.
Confidence and if-stop-now risk/action artifacts remain visible for readiness decisions.
Planning Handoff carries research follow-up provenance into build-slice evidence.
Blocker artifacts use explicit source-trace incomplete states when evidence is insufficient.
ChatGPT/browser delegation keeps disclosure preview, approval, evidence refs, and revoke controls visible.
Service-page permissions require user-present login, action echo, artifact cleanup, and revoke checks.
Loopback-only browser smokes prove boundaries without ChatGPT credentials or external network access.
Final submit remains blocked until a future production-mutation contract exists.
Runtime preview requests produce bounded preview artifacts without applying file, shell, browser, or network actions.
Worker jobs keep planned ledger docs, authority refs, sandbox boundaries, and manual recovery evidence visible.
Generated PR open/body-update/merge mutations are guarded by stage evidence and duplicate-mutation checks.
Every canonical auto-implementation stage can carry code-review, clean-code, missing-test audit, and test evidence before completion.
The local technical-preview bundle can still be built and smoke-tested without credentials.
Broad/general release remains separately blocked until signed package, updater rollback, and Windows device gates pass.
Credential-free product/release diagnostics expose blocker issues without collecting secret values.
Product capability readiness does not reinterpret release blockers as ready distribution evidence.
